text:
Clare: quick q — can we add a per-invocation field like `effective_token_cost` to /telemetry/ingest so the console can render a last-24h marginal-cost heatmap? we'd need prefetch and cache-savings attribution included. also want to wire this into canary cost preview UX.

Ajay: hmm, exposing raw per-invocation cost to the telemetry stream sounds risky from a billing/abuse angle. Could we instead emit a derived `cost_bucket` or a compact `cost_components` summary? :thinking:

Clare: I hear that. The heatmap needs something numeric though. Proposed minimal fields: `model_sku`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cache_hit_cost_delta`, `prefetch_credit_applied`, `sampling_rate`. We can gate the econ fields behind an enterprise opt-in flag to reduce exposure.

Nate: prefer an opaque `econ_signal` object that contains the component numbers (base, kv_hit_savings, prefetch_credit). Also tag `sampled=true/false`. Example payload we could accept in ingest (sent as a single string/JSON blob):

```json
{ "request_id": "req_123", "tenant_id": "t-xyz", "model_sku": "gptx-8k", "tokens_in": 42, "tokens_out": 128, "econ_signal": { "base_cost": 0.0012, "kv_savings": 0.0004, "prefetch_credit": 0.0001 }, "sampling_rate": 0.05, "sampled": true }
```

Ajay: two quick concerns — (1) customers might infer internal pricing if we return fine-grained floats; (2) audit/billing reconciliation: we must ensure telemetry-derived numbers never become the source of truth for invoices. Suggest we send quantized values (e.g., micros or integer cents-per-1000-tokens) and mark them `billing_safe=false` by default.

Clare: fair. We can quantize to integer micros and include a `billing_safe` boolean. The console heatmap is purely for observability and can be disabled for customers who want less telemetry surface. We'll also add a note in the onboarding flow.

cost-bot: schema-lint: `econ_signal` size <=1KB, `sampling_rate` required, `tenant_scoped_hash` recommended. :white_check_mark:

Nate: operational note — when we compute the canary preview we should simulate routing fallback to cheaper model variants and show a projected delta column (expected extra cost if primary model stays). That needs `route_affinity` context and `secondary_sku_estimate`.

Ajay: good point. Also add a `retention_days` header for these fields; default 7 days for high-cardinality econ data. Legal will want the wording for the canary cost preview — I'll take that.

Clare: ok i'll own the console UI changes and the onboarding copy. can eng-platform add the ingest parser and opt-in flag by EOD Friday?

Nate: i can add parser + sampler in ingest service, wire the `econ_signal` to the metrics pipeline (sampled) and add tests. ETA Wednesday. :thumbsup:

Ajay: i'll loop in legal and product to approve the flag text. thanks all.

Clare: thanks — filing a tiny RFC with schema example and opt-in checklist now.
